node.title: Re: Redirect a substring/desired values from a System output to a file in Perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Assuming that the output fits in memory, you can get the output as an array of lines by using [doc://perlop#qx/_STRING_/|qx// aka ``] in list context, and then use [doc://grep]. However, I would recommend using capturex from [mod://IPC::System::Simple] because there are potential security issues with qx//, or, if the output can become too large to sensibly fit into memory, there are other methods/modules to run the external program and get its output line-by-line, similar to what [Discipulus] [id://1219366|showed]. See my post on these topics [id://1180578|here] (with lots of example code).

use warnings; use strict; use IPC::System::Simple qw/capturex/; my @cmd = ('cat', 'sample.txt'); # just an example print map { s/^_id://; $_ } grep { /^_id:/ } capturex(@cmd);

Note that map { s/^_id://; $_ } grep { /^_id:/ } can be written more briefly as grep { s/^_id:// }, although people often recommend against using grep for its side-effects.
